name: Tateoka Yuugo
source: A teacher able to manipulate the body of another person at his discretion. After having his memories and abilities sealed, he was looked down on by his Co-workers and students. This changed after seeing Sayuki, seeing her acted as a trigger and he regained his past memories and abilities. He is now again attacking his prey while playing the pitiful teacher on the outside.
